violations.why: The ISR can preempt the task between line 26 and line 28 and repoint v_tundra to its own local. The task's read at line 28 then sees the ISR's value instead of &v_quartz.
The ISR can change v_tundra between the task's two reads at lines 28 and 29, so the two dereferences can go to different targets.
v_timber and v_indigo both point to v_vessel. The ISR can read it at line 9 between the task's writes at lines 23 and 24 and see the intermediate value 2 instead of the final 3.
